spans.text: 45, why are you spacing out in front of that piece of equipment?
I'm just thinking what parts these newest machines contain.
Don't be so stingy. If you've got damaged parts to replace, just go to Dier.
Destroy all the equipment in here. Leave nothing for the enemy!
Strange, isn't it? They are the same parts. When given to us, they serve the purpose of protecting humans.
But when equipped to these machines, they become weapons that take human lives.
Stop thinking about such nonsense. Hurry up and tear everything apart.
